name: Virunga National Park
description: Virunga National Park stretches about 300 km along the eastern edge of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, beside the borders with Uganda and Rwanda. Its landscapes run from lava plains and savannah to the glaciers of the Rwenzori Mountains, and include two active volcanoes, Nyiragongo and Nyamuragira. Mountain gorillas live here, and the park has been listed as in danger since 1994 because of conflict in the region.
